Before you publish this: this is a plain-language starting draft, not a substitute for a lawyer familiar with your country's data-protection law (e.g. NDPR in Nigeria, GDPR if you have EU users, CCPA for California). Have it reviewed before this app processes real payments.

What we collect

If you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email address, and profile photo from Google. If you use Guest mode, we collect nothing — nothing you add is saved once you close the app.

We store the scripture collections, tags, and colors you create so they can sync across your devices when you're signed in.

What we don't collect

We don't collect payment card details directly — if you subscribe to Premium, that's handled entirely by our payment processor (Lemon Squeezy), who has their own privacy policy.

Who else sees data, and why

  • Google — for signing in.
  • Supabase — hosts our database (your collections, tags, and account link).
  • Netlify — hosts the app itself.
  • Groq — if you use "Describe it" search, your search text is sent to Groq to identify possible Bible references. Groq never receives or generates scripture text itself — only reference suggestions (e.g. "John 3:16"), which we then look up separately.
  • Microsoft (Edge TTS) — the text of a verse and its reference are sent to Microsoft's text-to-speech service to generate the audio you hear.
  • bible-api.com — verse references are sent here to retrieve the exact public-domain scripture text.

Your choices

You can export all your data at any time from the app (Export button). You can delete your account and data by contacting us at [add your support email].

Children

Tapestry is not directed at children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect data from them.

Changes

If this policy changes in a meaningful way, we'll update the date at the top of this page.
